newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Volumes light in Bucharest bourse dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Volumes light in Bucharest bourse dull trading.

text.p: Bucharest shares traded in low volumes on Thursday, with turnover inching up 1.0 million lei, but remaining low at 27.4 million amid scant demand.
"The only thing that comes to mind to outline this session is dull," said a trader. "We expected more buying orders for today but we got it wrong."
Three stocks edged up, five closed weaker, three were flat and three had no trade. Syringe maker Sanevit SA remained suspended for the fourth week pending an annoucement.
Newcomer Uztel SA, an oilfield equipment maker, put on a weak show with only three transactions involving 130 shares. Its price shed 1,000 lei from the opening to close at 4,000.
Buying interest once again focused on Azomures SA fertiliser maker which took 55 percent of turnover. It closed unchanged at 11,000 lei.
"This is the most liquid stock on the exchange, one investors like best. It will be in the limelight until other equally good companies join trading," said a broker.
The exchange expects another 10 companies to come to trading before year's end.

Two unofficial value-weighted indices -- the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA securities, and the Bucharest Investment Group 's BIG -- slipped from the previous session. The VAB fell by 1.1 percent to 294.2 points and the BIG dropped by 1.07 percent to 293.41 points.
Prices are on MRRO and MRRP.
